body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a Storybook build failure caused by two MDX files declaring the same Meta title `"Getting Started/Introduction"`. Both files were matched by the glob pattern `../packages/**/src/**/*.mdx` in `.storybook/main.ts`, causing Storybook's indexer to fail with an "Unable to index" error due to duplicate titles.

**Changes:**
- Removed the shorter duplicate Introduction.mdx (62 lines) from `packages/components/src/stories/` directory, keeping the more comprehensive 128-line version in `packages/components/src/stories-json/`
